title: Not even a straw broken
literal_meaning: Not to break one piece of straw into two.
explanation: This expression makes a very small action stand for any contribution at all. Saying that someone has not done even this means they have done no work in the situation being discussed. It is an idiomatic phrase rather than a complete rhymed maxim.
usage_example: Several people clean up after a gathering while one person only gives instructions. Someone complains that the person has not lifted a finger—the comparable English idiom. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Straw provides a small, light object in the verbal image. The comparison with an English idiom explains the sense; it is not a claim of translation, borrowing or shared origin.
